metaDescription: Courses, on-demand webinars, YouTube tutorials and podcast appearances on veterinary clinical pathology and AI literacy from Candice P. Chu.

philosophy.label: Core Belief
philosophy.title: Technology as an equalizer
philosophy.body: AI and digital tools can democratize access to high-quality veterinary education — making expert-level knowledge available to learners regardless of institutional resources or geography.

philosophy.label: Approach
philosophy.title: Hands-on, evidence-based learning
philosophy.body: Students learn best by doing. Courses are built around real clinical cases, live AI tool demonstrations, and critical evaluation exercises — not passive lectures.

philosophy.label: Responsibility
philosophy.title: Critical AI literacy
philosophy.body: Transformative potential must be paired with critical thinking. Students learn to recognize AI limitations — hallucination, bias, and ethical considerations — alongside practical applications.

philosophy.label: Mission
philosophy.title: Train next-generation veterinarians
philosophy.body: Veterinary professionals who can confidently evaluate, communicate about, and responsibly implement AI tools — no programming background required.
